item: A local-AI address is shown with its sign-in details and query values masked, in Settings, errors, logs and diagnostics
summary: A password or token in OO_OLLAMA_URL or OO_VLLM_URL reached the status, error text and logs. shown_address masks it everywhere the address is reported; raise_for_status masks the httpx status error's own text where it is made, so a logged traceback, a redirect Location and an error without a request are clean too; a password holding / # or ? is masked. The sink-sweep allowlist lost _raw_url_masked and classifies each use instead. Red before the fix (9 tests), green after.
